part.text:
Refactored the SSG onto a plugin architecture:

- **`src/plugin.ts`** — `Plugin` interface (`onStart`, `beforeBuild`, `afterBuild`, `onFile(page)`, `onEnd`), `PluginContext`, `PluginFile`, and `PluginManager` which runs each hook across all plugins in order (hooks bound to the plugin instance).
- **`src/plugins/`** — built-in plugins: `MarkdownPlugin` (frontmatter + markdown→HTML), `TemplatePlugin` (handlebars/layouts/partials or built-in renderer), `DevServerPlugin` (HTTP server, static serving, WebSocket live-reload, watch+rebuild). Barrel re-exports at top-level `plugins/` per the `./plugins/` convention.
- **`src/config.ts`** — `loadConfig()` reads `ssg.config.ts` (transpiles TS at runtime, resolves relative plugin modules from `./plugins/`).
- **`src/engine.ts`** — `SSGEngine` orchestrates the pipeline: `onStart → beforeBuild → onFile (per page) → write files → afterBuild → onEnd`, merging built-ins with config/explicit plugins.
- **`src/generator.ts`, `src/serve.ts`, `src/cli.ts`** — refactored to delegate to the engine/plugins; all original exports (`buildSite`, `loadPages`, `renderPage`, `renderIndex`, `toSlug`, `startServe`, `serve`, `DEFAULT_PORT`, etc.) preserved with identical CLI/output behavior. `buildSite`/`serve` now accept `plugins`/`configPath`.
